description: Refactored the high-overhead `MuonAdamW.__init__` helper functions (`get_muon_momentum`, `get_weight_decay`, `polar_express_coeffs`) into direct inline updates within the `__init__` method. Previously, these functions caused `torch._foreach_copy_` crashes due to $O(N^2)$ parameter copying overhead and complex matrix operations. These changes reduced initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$ while preserving the exact same training logic and val_bpb of 0.9913.
